PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Results-driven Business Analyst with 10+ years of experience across investment banking, custody and 
securities operations, client assets, treasury-related operations, OTC derivatives, financial reporting, regulatory 
assurance and regulatory processes. Proven track record of translating complex business requirements into 
data-driven solutions, bridging the gap between business stakeholders and technology teams, and delivering 
automation initiatives that generate measurable efficiency gains. 
 
Hands-on experience across Custody Operations, Client Asset / Asset Protection activities, CASS and CSDR 
requirements, including cash and securities reconciliation, position validation, trade settlements, corporate 
actions, custody/broker reconciliation, exception management and asset-related control processes. 
Experienced in Regulatory Assurance and Control Frameworks, including control monitoring, risk assessment, 
control validation, exception investigation, root-cause analysis, remediation and compliance monitoring.  
 
Strong experience in Regulatory Change Management and Regulatory Impact Assessment, assessing regulatory 
changes across business processes, data, systems and controls and coordinating implementation with 
Operations, Risk, Compliance and Technology teams. 
 
Experienced in partnering with Trading, Operations, Risk, Technology, Compliance and regional stakeholders to 
deliver regulatory and control solutions with minimal business impact, including CASS, CSDR, SFTR, EMIR, 
MIFID, CFTC and Dodd-Frank regulatory requirements.
